thesis: Mohnish Pabrai describes his 2013 startup Gandhigiri, which aimed to fight corruption in India by teaching citizens to use RTI laws and recording interactions with government officials to create transparency. He explains that the project was eventually abandoned due to team availability and scaling issues with his charity, Dakshana, but he suggests that the concept remains relevant and could be resurrected by the audience.
